list.empty: No materials yet. Add materials to organize specifications and quantities.
list.emptyCustomer: No materials have been shared yet.

toast.savedReconfirm: Key details changed, so this material now needs reconfirmation. Customers with the confirm right were notified.

form.coreChangeWarning: Changing the name, category, space, specification, quantity, unit, unit price, or image will mark a confirmed material as needing reconfirmation.
form.priceHint: Unit price is in whole Korean won. Note in the description whether VAT is included.
form.categoryHint: Pick an existing category or type a new one (up to 40 characters).

confirm.title: Confirm this material?
confirm.body: This records your agreement to the specification, quantity, and price shown. You can’t undo a confirmation yourself.
confirm.stale: The content has changed. Refresh and review it again.

state.needsReconfirm: This material changed and needs your confirmation again. Review the changes, then confirm.
state.pmNeedsReconfirm: Waiting for the customer to confirm again. Only the customer can change the confirmation.

reconfirm.title: Request reconfirmation?
reconfirm.body: Enter a reason. The material will be marked as needing reconfirmation and customers with the confirm right will be notified.

publish.title: Share this material with the customer?
publish.body: The customer will see the spec, quantity and unit price. Sharing is not confirmation.
